# j3w1 UI Theme Spec

> Versioned design tokens and component rules for the j3w1 identity: True Black / Rose, rose foregrounds, dark-red actions, square borders and monospace typography. Version 1.0.0. Agents: use pinned canonical contracts and official package or complete copy distributions.

Pin a tag or commit and use the same revision for every file. Never read `main`.

## Start here

- [Reading protocol](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/j3w1/theme/v1.0.0/agents/consume.md): the seven steps, what you may not do, the lock and report formats
- [Manifest](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/j3w1/theme/v1.0.0/theme.json): profiles, entry points, export paths
- [Compact spec](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/j3w1/theme/v1.0.0/exports/theme.compact.md): approved values, state rules, ten component briefs
- [Implementation index](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/j3w1/theme/v1.0.0/packages/ui/dist/index.json): bounded discovery for all 67 official implementations
- [Consumption guide](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/j3w1/theme/v1.0.0/docs/ui-consumption.md): package, copy and mapping modes in HTML, Vue, React and Astro
- [Implementation manifest](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/j3w1/theme/v1.0.0/packages/ui/dist/manifest.json): APIs, dependency closures, copy file digests and canonical links; actual execution evidence is separate

## Data

- [Resolved tokens](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/j3w1/theme/v1.0.0/exports/tokens.resolved.json): every profile, every alias resolved
- [Token CSS](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/j3w1/theme/v1.0.0/exports/tokens.css): the same values as custom properties
- [Component JSON](https://github.com/j3w1/theme/tree/v1.0.0/exports/components): one file per component
- [Digests](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/j3w1/theme/v1.0.0/exports/digests.json): sha256 per export for theme.lock.json

## Optional

- [Full spec](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/j3w1/theme/v1.0.0/exports/theme.full.md): everything concatenated
- [Contrast report](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/j3w1/theme/v1.0.0/exports/contrast.md): every declared pair, unrounded
- [Website](https://j3w1.github.io/theme/): rendered specimens for visual confirmation
